fact: The Ministry of Gender, Youth and Social Development, with EU financing and UNICEF technical assistance, issued a Request for Proposals for the NISSA social registry and MISSA, closing 12 August 2024.
source_slug: 2024-01-01 Lesotho — RFP for NISSA social registry and MISSA

fact: The ministry says NISSA, the national social registry run by the Director of Social Assistance, currently holds 90% (488,000) of Basotho households across all 10 districts, and is being updated through the World Bank-financed PSLP.
